notes: ACCESS: direct curl_cffi (chrome-impersonation) 200'd on westelm.com homepage, robots.txt and the netstorage sitemap XML/gz files, but 403'd (Akamai 'Restricted Access') on every /shop/ PLP path, both via curl_cffi and headless Playwright/Chromium. Real Chrome via the Claude-in-Chrome connector was used as the working route for all /shop/ page loads (no Claude-specific Disallow in robots.txt, so tier-3 use is permitted). CHECKED FOR BESTSELLERS: (1) primary nav / mega-menu (both the live homepage HTML and llms.txt's Primary/Secondary Navigation listing) - no Best Sellers/Top Sellers/Popular/Trending/Customer Favorites entry anywhere, only New, Furniture, Outdoor, Rugs, Bedding, Bath, Lighting, Pillows & Decor, Window, Art & Mirrors, Kitchen & Dining, Storage, Gifts, Sale. (3) Sitemap check: fetched shop-sitemap-1.xml.gz (883 URLs) and thematic-sitemap-1.xml.gz (527 URLs) via direct HTTP and regex-filtered for best|popular|favorite|trending|top-sell|top-rated - zero genuine PLP matches (thematic sitemap's one 'best' hit is an unrelated SEO landing page '/shopping/best-fake-plants/', not a merchandising PLP). (4) Direct URL probes: /shop/best-sellers/ and equivalent guesses redirect to the homepage (no such page exists). (5) Site search for 'best sellers' via the search bar returns a plain '20 search results for "best sellers"' term-match grid (generic sofas/chairs) - this is a search-results page, explicitly excluded by the brief as a candidate regardless of the query. Per Rule 0 (a zero-result/negative search is not proof of absence on its own), absence here is corroborated independently by (1)-(4): no nav entry, no sitemap entry, no dedicated URL, and the only 'bestseller' wording in the site's own code is a per-product badge flag. CONCLUSION: West Elm US exposes no genuine Bestsellers/Top Sellers/Customer Favorites merchandising PLP; only a 'Bestseller' product badge exists, which the brief explicitly says does not qualify.
